text:
Morgan: quick check — token-cost attribution work: finalizing event schema and flagging remaining infra deps. Can owners call out any blockers?
Jia: I'm owner for the attrib mapping. main blocker is we need 'latency_ms' from eng-runtime traces (non-sampled) + token counts from the tokenizer service. Do we have ETA on the trace export?
Arun: eng-runtime: trace export is ready but needs a small change to add `request_id` and `seq_len` to the span attributes. I can push the patch tomorrow morning.
Morgan: thanks. is that enough for you Jia?
Jia: should be. also need clarity on event schema versioning — do we bump to v2 or add optional fields to v1?
Kevin: my thought: keep v1 backward-compatible and add optional fields (latency_ms, token_count, model_variant). We'll publish a migration doc.
Sam: FYI infra team needs to add a routing tag for 'env=prod' to the telemetry stream so we can attribute cost-per-environment. Pinged infra on the ticket.
Arun: noted. @deploy-bot can we get the deploy queue status for telemetry-export?
deploy-bot: Telemetry-export pipeline: queued (2), running (1), next window 03:15 UTC. ETA for next deploy ~45m.
Jia: great — once the payload includes `request_id` + `token_count`, I can map tokens -> cost using model unit rates. I'll open the mapping PR today.
Morgan: can you include a sample event in the PR so reviewers can sanity-check?
Jia: yes — sample payload I'm planning to include:
```json
{
  "event_version": "v1",
  "request_id": "req_123",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-17T15:12:01Z",
  "model": "redwood-v2-large",
  "model_variant": "quantized-q4_0",
  "token_count": 125,
  "latency_ms": 324,
  "env": "prod",
  "route": "/api/v1/generate",
  "meta": {"user_type": "internal"}
}
```
Arun: small ask — can we make `token_count` an integer and add `token_source` (client/tokenizer) to disambiguate?
Jia: sure — I'll add `token_source`.
Kevin: when you open the PR, tag the cost-modeling folks and add `needs-canary: true` label so we can run a limited rollout.
Jia: PR: https://github.com/redwood/instrumentation/pull/489 — draft up now. pinging @Arun and @Kevin for review.
Sam: I left comments on infra ticket about adding `env` tags at the router level; engineering-ops to confirm config change.
Morgan: timeline check — can we get schema PR and runtime trace patch in by EOD tomorrow? That keeps us on track for canary next week.
Arun: I can ship the runtime patch tomorrow morning, then will coordinate with deploy for the 03:15 window.
Kevin: I'll review Jia's PR today and leave feedback. If all green, I'll approve and we can schedule canary.
Jia: thanks. one more question — for cost attribution, do we divide tokens by model variant performance (p50 throughput) or use raw token counts * unit price? That affects our billing config.
Morgan: short-term: raw token_count * unit price (simpler). Long-term we should normalize by effective token cost per variant. Add it to roadmap.md.
Sam: ack. I'll follow up with Finance on unit price confirmation (usd/token).
Kevin: note: we also want to capture prompt vs completion tokens. Can we add `token_breakdown: {"prompt": 40, "completion": 85}` as optional?
Jia: yep will include `token_breakdown` as optional object.
Morgan: outstanding action items: Jia -> open PR w/ sample + schema changes; Arun -> runtime span attrs patch; Kevin -> review + label; Sam -> infra tag + finance unit price; Morgan -> coordinate canary window. I'll update the project board after PR lands.
Arun: starting the runtime patch now.
Jia: PR created (draft): https://github.com/redwood/instrumentation/pull/489 — added sample events, schema bump notes, and TODOs for canary.
Kevin: reviewing now.
Sam: infra confirmed config change scheduled for next router deploy.
Morgan: perfect. We'll reconvene async here if any blockers, otherwise we'll aim for canary on Mon. :thumbsup:
